messages:
kevin: Heads-up — opened a small PR to tighten authz checks and add audit log fields for KMS key usage. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8472 :eyes:

kevin: Summary: validate caller identity in the rotation endpoint, add `kms_key_id` to audit entries, and make the audit logger async to avoid blocking retries. Changes are mostly in authz.go and audit/middleware.go

sasha: on it, leaving :eyes: for the code path that touches rotation flows.

vivian: Quick skim — looks fine but two nits: 1) the new audit field name `kms_key_id` vs `kms_key` should match existing telemetry, 2) async logger panics need to be swallowed or will surface to the caller.

kevin: thanks — fixed the field name mismatch and added Recover() in the goroutine, pushed. CI rerun: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8472/checks

ci-bot: All checks passed — unit tests, go vet, and policy checks green.

maria: @sasha @alex if either of you can approve the authz bits? need 1 more approval to merge today for the compliance window.

alex: can take a look in ~30m, heads-up about the compliance deadline. If I see anything blocking i'll flag it.

sasha: Approved. left one comment about log verbosity (suggested DEBUG for the success path). :thumbsup:

vivian: +1 from me as long as the async logger swallow behavior is explicit. small comment added.

kevin: Appreciate it — addressed the verbosity comment and added a short note in the PR description explaining why success is info vs debug.

maria: Great. Merging after 1pm PT if no objections. tagging release lead.

kevin: TL;DR for release notes: "Authz: tighten rotation endpoint authorization; Audit: include KMS key id in audit entries; improve resiliency of audit pipeline."

alex: no objections. merge when ready. :white_check_mark:

kevin: merged. thanks y'all.

ci-bot: Deploy pipeline started for infra/main — patch rollout to staging. Logs: `deploy/infra/staging/1791005`

vivian: I'll watch staging for audit log format and notify compliance once staging shows updated entries.

maria: thanks, team. If compliance needs any follow-up, ping me.
